mainTopic: The jobs done at the southwest corner of the מזבח below and above the חוט הסיקרא, and רבי יוחנן's explanations about the עולת העוף and the נסכים.
overview: The amud opens by finishing a ברייתא from the previous daf. In that version, a חטאת העוף is valid even if its blood was only sprinkled and not squeezed out, as long as some blood went below the red line. The גמרא then gives a source for each of the three jobs done at the southwest corner below the line: the חטאת העוף, the הגשה of מנחות, and pouring the שירי הדם. Next it turns to the jobs done above the line. It asks why an עולת העוף normally belongs at the southeast corner, and רבי יוחנן answers that this corner is closest to the בית הדשן. רבי יוחנן then praises the strength of the כהנים, who could throw the light מוראה ונוצה more than thirty אמות. The גמרא checks this number against a משנה in תמיד and explains that the space where the כהן stands is not counted. Finally, רבי יוחנן explains that the כהנים doing the נסכים and the עולת העוף go straight to their corner so the smoke will not harm them. The גמרא challenges this from a משנה where the כהן גדול circles the מזבח and is then given wine to pour. רבי יוחנן's answer begins at the end of the amud and continues on the next amud.

steps.title: Finishing the ברייתא: sprinkling alone is enough
steps.stepSummary: The ברייתא ends by saying that if a חטאת העוף's blood was sprinkled but not squeezed out, the offering is still valid. The condition is that some of its blood was put below the red line.
steps.simpleTranslation: Because if he sprinkled the blood but did not squeeze it out, the offering is valid, as long as he puts some of the main blood from the red line and below.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא is finishing a ברייתא it began quoting on the previous daf, about where the blood of a bird חטאת must go.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Two blood actions are done with a חטאת העוף: sprinkling (הזאה) and squeezing out the rest (מיצוי). This version says squeezing is not essential, but sprinkling is, and it must be below the red line. So it does not matter where the blood was squeezed; what matters is that blood reached the lower half of the מזבח.

keyTerms.meaning: Sprinkling the blood onto the wall of the מזבח
Squeezing out the rest of the blood from the bird onto the מזבח
The red line around the middle of the מזבח, dividing upper from lower
The life-blood, the main blood that comes out first

steps.whatToRemember: In this version, only the sprinkling below the red line is essential for a חטאת העוף. Squeezing out the blood is not essential.
steps.confusionAlert: This line starts in the middle of a sentence. The word "because" connects back to the ברייתא quoted at the end of the previous daf.

phrases.english: because if he sprinkled but did not squeeze out, it is valid;
provided that he places
from the red line and below
of the blood of the soul.
phrases.notes: He means the first, main blood of the bird, the blood that is sprinkled.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Finishes a ברייתא begun on the previous daf.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: A חטאת העוף is valid without מיצוי, as long as its blood was sprinkled below the חוט הסיקרא.

steps.title: Source for the bird sin offering at the southwest corner
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא returns to the משנה's list of three things done at the southwest corner below the line. For the first item, the חטאת העוף, it points back to a source it already gave.
steps.simpleTranslation: The משנה said: three things are done at the lower southwest corner. The bird sin offering: that is what we already said.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא quotes the משנה again and starts giving a source for each of its three items. The first source was already given earlier.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The משנה lists three jobs for the lower southwest corner: חטאת העוף, הגשות, and שירי הדם. For the first one, no new proof is needed. The earlier proof (63b) already showed that a חטאת העוף is done at the southwest corner, by comparing it to מנחות.

keyTerms.meaning: Three things, the opening words of this part of the משנה

phrases.english: Three matters, etc.
The bird sin offering: that which we said.
phrases.notes: This points back to the proof on the previous daf, which compared it to מנחות.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Leaves the ברייתא and returns to the next line of the משנה.
steps.raayaObject: That a חטאת העוף is done at the southwest corner below the line.

steps.title: Source for bringing meal offerings near the altar
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא brings a פסוק to show that the הגשה of מנחות is done at the southwest corner.
steps.simpleTranslation: The bringing near of meal offerings: as it is written, "And he shall bring it to the front of the מזבח."
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא gives the source for the second item on the משנה's list, the הגשה of a מנחה.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Before a handful (קמיצה) is taken from many מנחות, the כהן brings the מנחה to touch the corner of the מזבח. The פסוק says "to the front of the מזבח," and the גמרא uses this to place the הגשה at the southwest corner.

keyTerms.meaning: Bringing the מנחות near to the corner of the מזבח

phrases.english: The bringing near: as it is written:
"And he shall bring it to the front of the altar."

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Second item in the list of sources for the משנה.
steps.raayaObject: That הגשת מנחות is done at the southwest corner.

steps.title: Source for pouring out the leftover blood
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא brings a פסוק to show that the שירי הדם are poured at the base of the מזבח, which was explained earlier to mean the southwest base.
steps.simpleTranslation: The leftover blood: as it is written, "And all the blood of the bull he shall pour out at the base of the מזבח."
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא gives the source for the third and last item on the משנה's list, the שירי הדם.
steps.deeperAnalysis: After the required blood placements, the blood left over is poured onto the יסוד, the base of the מזבח. The פסוק says to pour it at the יסוד. Earlier in the מסכת, that was shown to be the southwest יסוד. This completes the sources for all three items below the line.

keyTerms.meaning: The leftover blood after the required placements

steps.whatToRemember: All three jobs below the line at the southwest corner now have a source: חטאת העוף (from earlier), הגשות (from "פני המזבח"), and שירי הדם (from "יסוד המזבח").

phrases.english: The remaining blood: as it is written:
"And all the blood of the bull
he shall pour out at the base of the altar."
phrases.notes: ויקרא 4:7. The גמרא showed earlier (53a) that this means the southwest base.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Third and final item in the list of sources for the lower section.
steps.raayaObject: That שירי הדם are poured at the southwest יסוד.
steps.raayaSupportSource: ויקרא 4:7, "ואת כל דם הפר ישפך אל יסוד המזבח".

steps.title: Quoting the משנה: what is done above the line
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא quotes the next part of the משנה, which lists the jobs done at the southwest corner above the red line.
steps.simpleTranslation: Above the line: the water libation, the wine libation, and the bird burnt offering when there are too many in the east.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא quotes the משנה's list of jobs done above the red line. This sets up the question that comes next.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Above the line at the southwest corner, the libations of water (on סוכות) and wine are poured. An עולת העוף is also done there, but only when the east side is too crowded. That means the normal place for an עולת העוף is the southeast corner.

keyTerms.meaning: Above, meaning above the red line
Too many in the east, meaning crowded at the southeast corner

steps.confusionAlert: The southwest corner is not the usual place for an עולת העוף. It is used only when the southeast corner is too crowded.

phrases.english: Above: the water libation,
and the wine, and the bird burnt offering
when it is numerous in the east.
phrases.notes: He means that so many are being brought that the southeast corner is overloaded.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Moves on to the next clause of the משנה.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: The libations, and an עולת העוף when the east is crowded, are done above the line at the southwest corner.

steps.title: Why the bird burnt offering belongs in the east
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא asks why the normal place for an עולת העוף is the southeast corner.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא asks a simple question about the reason. It is setting up רבי יוחנן's answer in the next step.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The משנה implies that an עולת העוף is normally done in the east, at the southeast corner. The גמרא wants to know why that corner was chosen.

phrases.english: What is the reason?

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Asks about the reason behind the משנה just quoted.
steps.sheelahInformationSought: Why the עולת העוף is normally done at the southeast corner.

steps.title: רבי יוחנן: it is closest to the ash place
steps.stepSummary: רבי יוחנן explains that the southeast corner is used because it is the closest corner to the בית הדשן.
steps.simpleTranslation: רבי יוחנן said: because it is close to the place of the ashes.
steps.whatsHappening: רבי יוחנן answers the question. The southeast corner is used because it is nearest to the בית הדשן.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The crop and feathers of an עולת העוף are thrown at the בית הדשן, east of the ramp. Doing the offering at the nearest corner makes that easy. Only when that corner is overcrowded do they move to the southwest.

keyTerms.meaning: The place of the ashes, east of the ramp, where the crop and feathers are thrown

steps.whatToRemember: The עולת העוף is normally done at the southeast corner because it is nearest to the בית הדשן.

phrases.english: Rabbi Yoḥanan says:
Because it is close to the place of the ashes.

steps.triggerLanguage: רַבִּי יוֹחָנָן אָמַר: מִפְּנֵי שֶׁקְּרוֹבָה מִבֵּית הַדֶּשֶׁן
steps.teshuvahAnswerProvided: The southeast corner is the closest one to the בית הדשן.

steps.title: The great strength of the priests
steps.stepSummary: רבי יוחנן says the כהנים were so strong that they could throw the light מוראה ונוצה of a bird more than thirty אמות.
steps.simpleTranslation: רבי יוחנן said: Come and see how strong the כהנים were. Nothing on a bird is lighter than the crop and feathers, yet sometimes the כהן threw them more than thirty אמות.
steps.whatsHappening: רבי יוחנן makes a statement praising the strength of the כהנים. The מוראה ונוצה are very light, yet the כהן threw them a very long distance.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Light things are the hardest to throw far, because they do not carry well through the air. When the עולת העוף was done at the southwest corner, the כהן still had to get the מוראה ונוצה over to the ashes pile on the east side. Throwing them more than thirty אמות from there shows great strength.

keyTerms.meaning: The crop of the bird, which is removed and not burned on the מזבח
Feathers (or, by some explanations, the bird's innards)
A cubit, a measure of length

phrases.english: Rabbi Yochanan said:

phrases.aramaic: בֹּא וּרְאֵה כַּמָּה גָּדוֹל כֹּחָן שֶׁל כֹּהֲנִים –
phrases.english: Come and see how great the strength of the priests was –
for you have nothing lighter in birds
than the crop and feathers,
phrases.notes: These parts are taken off the bird and thrown to the ashes pile instead of being burned on the מזבח.

phrases.english: and sometimes the priest would throw them
more than thirty cubits.

steps.triggerLanguage: אָמַר רַבִּי יוֹחָנָן: בֹּא וּרְאֵה כַּמָּה גָּדוֹל כֹּחָן שֶׁל כֹּהֲנִים
steps.relationToPreviousStep: After explaining where the עולת העוף is normally done, the גמרא adds a side comment about throwing its discarded parts.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: The כהנים sometimes threw the very light מוראה ונוצה more than thirty אמות.

steps.title: Where the ashes pile was located
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא quotes a משנה in תמיד that shows exactly where the מוראה ונוצה were placed, east of the ramp.
steps.simpleTranslation: As we learned: The כהן took a silver coal pan, went up to the top of the מזבח, pushed the coals to each side, and scooped up the inner burned coals, then went down. When he reached the floor he turned north and walked about ten אמות on the east side of the ramp. He piled the coals on the floor three טפחים away from the ramp. That is the place where they put the מוראה ונוצה and the ashes from the inner מזבח and the מנורה.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא brings a משנה to show where the ashes pile was. From that location we can figure out how far the כהן had to throw the מוראה ונוצה.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The משנה describes the תרומת הדשן and ends by naming the spot where the מוראה ונוצה go: east of the ramp, about ten אמות north, three טפחים from the ramp. A throw from the southwest corner of the מזבח to that spot is a very long distance, which supports רבי יוחנן's claim of more than thirty אמות.

keyTerms.meaning: A coal pan, used to scoop coals
The ramp leading up to the מזבח
The floor of the עזרה (Temple courtyard)
Handbreadths, a small measure of length

phrases.english: As we learned in a mishna: He took a coal pan of silver,
and went up to the top of the altar,
and cleared the coals to this side and that side,
and scooped from the inner, consumed coals, and goes down.

phrases.aramaic: הִגִּיעַ לָרִצְפָּה – מַחֲזִיר פָּנָיו כְּלַפֵּי צָפוֹן,
phrases.english: When he reached the floor – he turns his face toward the north,

phrases.aramaic: וְהוֹלֵךְ לְמִזְרָחוֹ שֶׁל כֶּבֶשׁ כְּעֶשֶׂר אַמּוֹת.
phrases.english: and walks along the east side of the ramp about ten cubits.

phrases.aramaic: צָבַר אֶת הַגֶּחָלִים עַל גַּבֵּי הָרִצְפָּה
phrases.english: He heaped the coals on the floor
three handbreadths away from the ramp –
the place where they put the crop and feathers,
and the ashes removed from the inner altar and the Menorah.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Supports רבי יוחנן's statement by showing where the throw ended.
steps.raayaObject: That the throw of the מוראה ונוצה covered a very long distance
steps.raayaSupportSource: משנה in מסכת תמיד describing the ashes pile east of the ramp

steps.title: The distance is really more than thirty-one
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא challenges: by this measurement the distance is more than thirty-one אמות, so why did רבי יוחנן say only 'more than thirty'?
steps.simpleTranslation: But these are more than thirty-one!
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא challenges רבי יוחנן's number. Measuring from the southwest corner to the ashes pile comes out to more than thirty-one אמות, not just 'more than thirty'.
steps.deeperAnalysis: If the real distance is past thirty-one, then saying 'more than thirty' seems to undercount. The גמרא expects רבי יוחנן's figure to match the measured distance and wants to know why it falls short.

phrases.english: These are more than thirty-one!
phrases.notes: He means the distance from the southwest corner to the ashes pile adds up to more than thirty-one אמות.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Uses the משנה's measurements to question רבי יוחנן's number.
steps.kashyaTarget: רבי יוחנן's statement that the throw was 'more than thirty אמות'
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: Measured from the משנה, the distance is more than thirty-one, so 'more than thirty' undercounts.

steps.title: The space of the people is not counted
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא answers that רבי יוחנן did not count the space taken up by the person standing there.
steps.simpleTranslation: The place of the people is not counted.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא answers the challenge. רבי יוחנן left out the space where the כהן himself stands, so his number is a bit smaller.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The full measurement includes the spot the כהן occupies. The actual throw only begins where his hand releases it, so that space does not count. Once you take it away, 'more than thirty' fits.

phrases.english: The place of the people he does not count.
phrases.notes: The space where the כהן stands is part of the measurement but not part of the actual throw.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers the challenge about the number.
steps.terutzResolutionType: Clarifies how the distance was measured
steps.terutzHavaAmina: The whole distance, including where the כהן stands, should be counted.
steps.terutzMaskana: The space taken up by the person is not counted, so 'more than thirty' is accurate.
steps.whatToRemember: רבי יוחנן's 'more than thirty אמות' counts only the throw itself, not the space where the כהן stands.

steps.title: Why the libations and bird offering are exceptions
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא asks why the כהנים doing the נסכים and the עולת העוף don't follow the usual path around the מזבח.
steps.simpleTranslation: All who go up to the מזבח... what is the reason?
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא moves to the next line of the משנה and asks for its reason. It wants to know why some כהנים are exceptions to the usual way of walking on the מזבח.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The משנה says everyone goes up on the right, walks all the way around, and comes down. The exceptions are the כהן doing the נסכים and the כהן doing the עולת העוף, who go straight to their corner. The גמרא asks why these jobs are different.

keyTerms.meaning: Those who go up onto the מזבח

phrases.english: All who go up to the altar – what is the reason?
phrases.notes: The גמרא quotes the משנה's opening words, but it's really asking about the exceptions: why the נסכים and עולת העוף don't go all the way around.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Starts a new topic from the next line of the משנה.
steps.sheelahInformationSought: Why the נסכים and the עולת העוף skip the usual walk around the מזבח
steps.confusionAlert: The question is not why everyone walks around. It is why these two jobs are exceptions and go straight to the southwest corner.

steps.title: The smoke could ruin them
steps.stepSummary: רבי יוחנן explains that walking around the fire could make the wine smell of smoke or make the bird die from the smoke.
steps.simpleTranslation: רבי יוחנן said: The נסכים, so they don't absorb smoke. The עולת העוף, so it doesn't die from the smoke.
steps.whatsHappening: רבי יוחנן answers the question. Walking all the way around the מזבח passes through the smoke, which would harm the נסכים and the bird.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The wine or water could soak up the smoke and take on its smell. The live bird could choke and die before it is offered, and then the מליקה could not be done properly. So these כהנים take the shortest path.

keyTerms.meaning: Libations of wine or water poured on the מזבח
A bird brought as a burnt offering

phrases.english: Rabbi Yochanan said:
Libations – lest they absorb smoke,
and the bird burnt offering – lest it die from the smoke.
phrases.notes: The bird is brought up alive, since it is killed on the מזבח itself.

steps.triggerLanguage: אָמַר רַבִּי יוֹחָנָן: נְסָכִים – שֶׁמָּא יִתְעַשְּׁנוּ
steps.teshuvahAnswerProvided: Going around the fire would expose the נסכים to smoke and could make the live bird die from the smoke.
steps.whatToRemember: The נסכים and עולת העוף go straight to their corner to keep them away from the smoke of the מזבח.

steps.title: A משנה shows the כהן walking around the מזבח before the wine
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא brings a משנה in תמיד: the כהן גדול circles the whole מזבח, corner by corner, and is given wine to pour. This seems to contradict רבי יוחנן's claim that the wine-pourer avoids circling because of the smoke.
steps.simpleTranslation: They pointed out a contradiction: When he comes to circle the מזבח, where does he start? From the southeast corner, then northeast, then northwest, then southwest. And they give him wine to pour! So the wine-pourer does walk around the fire.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא challenges רבי יוחנן from step 13 by quoting a משנה. In that משנה, the כהן walks all the way around the מזבח and is given wine for the נסכים.
steps.deeperAnalysis: רבי יוחנן said the כהן doing the נסכים skips the walk around the מזבח so the wine will not smell of smoke. Here the כהן גדול does walk around the fire, and the wine is still poured. If smoke were a real worry, the משנה would not describe it this way.

keyTerms.meaning: And they pointed out a contradiction (one source is set against another)

phrases.english: And they raised a contradiction:
When he comes to circle the altar,
phrases.notes: "He" is the כהן גדול doing the service of the daily offering.

phrases.english: from where does he start?
From the southeast corner,
then the northeast, then the northwest,
then the southwest;
and they give him wine to pour!

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Challenges the reason רבי יוחנן gave in step 13.
steps.kashyaTarget: רבי יוחנן's statement that the wine-pourer does not circle the מזבח because of the smoke.
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: The משנה in תמיד describes the כהן גדול circling the whole מזבח and then pouring wine. So circling the fire does not seem to stop the wine from being poured.

steps.title: רבי יוחנן begins his answer
steps.stepSummary: רבי יוחנן is introduced as the one who will settle the contradiction. His actual answer comes right after this.
steps.whatsHappening: This line sets up the next move: the גמרא introduces רבי יוחנן, who is about to answer the contradiction. His answer continues right after this line.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Only the opening words of the answer appear here. The point to keep in mind is that רבי יוחנן still has to explain how the משנה in תמיד fits with his own reason about the smoke.

phrases.english: Rabbi Yoḥanan says:

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Opens the answer to the contradiction raised in step 14.
steps.terutzResolutionType: Not yet given; the answer continues after this line.
steps.terutzHavaAmina: The משנה in תמיד seems to show that a כהן may circle the fire and still pour wine.
steps.terutzMaskana: Still to come: רבי יוחנן will explain how the משנה fits with his reason.
